data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel

data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 day3 IDs and 3921 RX8 day3 exploratory heldout on source cache17; IDs previously used under other channel views; all excluded student training; no V
